package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

// scenario for constructor_reads_env_directly: Constructors that call `os.Getenv` instead of receiving normalized config.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func NewDBConnection() (*sql.DB, error) {
	host := os.Getenv("DB_HOST")
	port := os.Getenv("DB_PORT")
	user := os.Getenv("DB_USER")
	pass := os.Getenv("DB_PASS")

	dsn := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s@tcp(%s:%s)/mydb", user, pass, host, port)
	db, err := sql.Open("mysql", dsn)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("constructor_reads_env_directly: %w", err)
	}
	return db, nil
}
